answer: The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, clawed back after a replayed submission, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Each submission hangs on the marble of a task receipt, and the copper is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. By the shale of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
